_provenance.what: SLAC E140's measured R = sigma_L/sigma_T on DEUTERIUM at x = 0.2, 0.35, 0.5, 1 <= Q2 <= 10 GeV2 (11 points) -- the reference side of the 'e140' (CLOSURE) sub-row of validation/benchmarks/t1_r_world.py (02_data_nucleon_deuteron.md sec. 4 R-2).

record.title: Measurement of kinematic and nuclear dependence of R = sigma-L / sigma-t in deep inelastic electron scattering

_provenance.tables_not_used: Tables 1-22 (cross sections per beam energy), 26-31 (R and F2 on Fe and Au): the tree's R has no target dependence (r_sigma_lt and r1998 take (x, Q2) only), so the nuclear tables are not compared; the paper's average R_A - R_D is kept below as a quoted fact.
_provenance.fetched: 2026-10-26 (UTC); the standard Python `requests` 2.25.1 client with its default identity (no header changed); curl's default identity receives HTTP 403 from www.hepdata.net and was not used
_provenance.licence: CC0-1.0: HEPData 'table_license' CC0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), read from each table's json download; measured quantities, vendored with attribution
_provenance.paper: S. Dasu et al. (SLAC E140), 'Measurement of kinematic and nuclear dependence of R = sigma_L/sigma_T in deep inelastic electron scattering', Phys. Rev. D 49 (1994) 5641, doi:10.1103/PhysRevD.49.5641 (read: PolarizedLithiumSim/refs/SLAC-PUB-5814.pdf, the SLAC-PUB-5814 preprint)
_provenance.publishing_convention: R is a RATIO (convention-free); these are the DEUTERIUM rows (record reaction 'E- DEUT --> E- X'). The paper's Table VII gives the same numbers with 'Statistical and point-to-point systematic errors shown separately. There is an additional normalization error of 0.03 primarily due to radiative corrections' -- that 0.03 is NOT in the record's numbers (its qualifier only says 'Additional normalization uncertainties'); it is kept here as paper_normalisation_error_r, quoted from the Table VII caption.
_provenance.errors: stat and point-to-point sys, separately, symmetric, absolute (as the paper's Table VII).

ra_minus_rd_average.source: sec. IV.B, SLAC-PUB-5814 p. 13: 'The average R_A - R_D is 0.001 +- 0.018(stat) +- 0.016(syst)'

_provenance.cross_check: all eleven rows (x, Q2, R, stat, sys) equal the deuterium rows of the paper's Table VII as printed (SLAC-PUB-5814 p. 30), checked number by number when this file was written
_provenance.in_r1998_fit: YES, through [3]: Whitlow et al. 1990 carries E140's R (its record's Table 2, 'Data from experiment E-140', the R_d/R_Fe average) and Abe et al., PLB 452 (1999) 194 fit 'the present data [3,11-14]'; E140's own PRL 61 (1988) 1061 is their ref. [8].

The harness that reads this file re-checks the sha256 of every byte of it, and of the canonical body (json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True)) recorded as `_body_sha256`, on every read.
